interface: Unmodified Org Workbench 0.2.0 browser build; same React renderer used by the Codex plugin. These are not full Codex application captures.
editing: Screenshots are direct browser captures. No UI, save state, or host chrome has been composited or hidden.

screenshots.caption: Rendered Org with a folding outline, tasks, and reading typography.
screenshots.alt: Org Workbench reading view, showing an outline on the left and the public field-notes.org document on the right.

screenshots.caption: Tasks and a table remain part of the same .org document.
screenshots.alt: Org Workbench showing a task checklist and a four-column table with aligned numeric values.

screenshots.caption: Org source and the rendered table side by side.
screenshots.alt: Split view with the original Org table syntax on the left and its rendered table on the right.

screenshots.caption: Editing a rendered table cell changes the original source; undo is shared.
screenshots.alt: After changing a table cell to Quiet morning, the same text is visible in the Org source and rendered table. The status bar shows unsaved changes.

screenshots.caption: Optional Nano-inspired typography in dark mode.
screenshots.alt: Org Workbench in dark mode with the Nano-inspired monospaced reading profile and the outline visible.

screenshots.caption: Reading controls: profile, text size, spacing, width, and table density.
screenshots.alt: The Reading appearance dialog, with Nano-inspired selected and controls for text size, line height, page width, and table density.
